en: Isaiah 3

p.src: 1  For, behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

en: For, behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;
u.src: 1  For, behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

en:
3:1 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
3:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 2  the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,

en: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,
u.src: 2  the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,

p.src: 3  the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

en: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.
u.src: 3  the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

p.src: 4  I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

en: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.
u.src: 4  I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

p.src: 5  The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.

en: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.
u.src: 5  The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.

p.src: 6  Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

en: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”
u.src: 6  Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

p.src: 7  In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

en: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”
u.src: 7  In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

p.src: 8  For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

en: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
u.src: 8  For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

en: 3:8 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 9  The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

en: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.
u.src: 9  The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

p.src: 10  Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.

en: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.
u.src: 10  Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.

p.src: 11  Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them.

en: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them.
u.src: 11  Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them.

p.src: 12  As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

en: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.
u.src: 12  As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

p.src: 13  The LORD stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

en: The LORD stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.
u.src: 13  The LORD stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

p.src: 14  The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.

en: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.
u.src: 14  The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.

p.src: 15  What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

en: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.
u.src: 15  What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

en: 3:15 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 16  Moreover the LORD said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

en: Moreover the LORD said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;
u.src: 16  Moreover the LORD said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

p.src: 17  therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald.”

en: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald.”
u.src: 17  therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald.”

p.src: 18  In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

en: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

p.src: 19  the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

en: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,
u.src: 19  the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

p.src: 20  the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume containers, the charms,

u.src: 20  the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume containers, the charms,

p.src: 21  the signet rings, the nose rings,

en: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

p.src: 23  the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

en: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.
u.src: 23  the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

p.src: 24  It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

en: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.
u.src: 24  It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

p.src: 25  Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

en: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.
u.src: 25  Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

p.src: 26  Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.

en: Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.
